title.zh: 角度与通道：倾斜不是固定万能值
title.en: Angle and channeling: no fixed tilt is universally best

subtitle.zh: Tilt / Twist / 晶向 / 深尾与阴影
subtitle.en: Tilt / twist / crystal orientation / deep tails and shadowing

body.en: 01 Identify wafer crystal orientation [001] [110]

body.zh: 02 设置倾角；法线
body.en: 02 Set tilt Normal

body.zh: 03 设置旋转角
body.en: 03 Set twist

body.zh: 04 离子进入晶格 05通道或去通道
body.en: 04 Ions enter the lattice; 05 channeling or dechanneling

body.zh: 06 深度轮廓验证；浓度；深度
body.en: 06 Validate the depth profile Concentration Depth

body.zh: 倾角；束流与晶圆法线；的夹角
body.en: Tilt Angle between the beam and wafer normal

body.zh: 旋转角；晶圆绕法线的；方位旋转角
body.en: Twist Azimuthal rotation of the wafer about its normal

body.zh: 晶圆晶向；不同晶向的通道；敏感性不同；[001]；［110］；［100］
body.en: Wafer crystal orientation Channeling sensitivity differs with crystal direction [001] [110] [100]

body.zh: 束流发散与能量；束流角度发散会增强；离子散射并影响深尾
body.en: Beam divergence and energy Angular beam divergence increases ion scattering and affects deep tails

body.zh: 沿开放晶向：易发生通道效应并产生深尾；沿晶向入射；离子轨迹更直、穿透更深
body.en: Along an open crystal direction: channeling readily produces deep tails Incidence along a crystal direction Straighter ion trajectories and deeper penetration

body.zh: 浓度；沿晶向；（通道深尾）；非通道；（参考）；深度
body.en: Concentration Along crystal direction (channeling tail) Nonchanneling (reference) Depth

body.zh: 沿开放晶向时，离子可沿原子排；列方向前进，导致更深的分布尾。
body.en: Along an open crystal direction, ions can travel along atomic rows, producing a deeper distribution tail.

body.zh: 倾斜/ 旋转后：增强散射，抑制通道深尾；倾斜 / 旋转入射；增加原子碰撞，去通道
body.en: After tilt / twist: more scattering suppresses channeling tails Tilted / twisted incidence More atomic collisions cause dechanneling

body.zh: 浓度；倾斜/旋转（去通道）；沿晶向（通道深尾）；深度
body.en: Concentration Tilt / twist (dechanneling) Along crystal direction (channeling tail) Depth

body.zh: 倾斜或旋转可破坏与晶向的对准，；通过散射抑制通道并减小深尾。
body.en: Tilt or twist breaks alignment with the crystal direction, suppressing channeling and deep tails through scattering.

body.zh: 高掩膜下的阴影效应：倾斜注入的权衡；背风侧；欠注入阴影；迎风侧；注入较强
body.en: Shadowing under tall masks: a tilted-implant tradeoff Leeward side Underimplanted shadow Windward side Stronger implantation

body.zh: 核心提示；不存在脱离晶向、能量和图形的通用最佳角度
body.en: Key point There is no universal optimum angle independent of crystal orientation, energy and pattern

body.zh: 工艺耦合与权衡；抑制通道深尾 ↔ 高台阶掩膜阴影与左右不对称
body.en: Process coupling and tradeoffs Suppressing channeling tails ↔ tall-mask shadowing and left-right asymmetry

body.zh: 常见风险；通道深尾；方位差异；掩膜阴影；装载角错误
body.en: Common risks Channeling tail Azimuth differences Mask shadowing Loading-angle error

body.zh: 量测反馈：角度分组SIMS / 片阻图/截面与电性；角度分组；进行SIMS分析
body.en: Metrology feedback: angle-grouped SIMS / sheet-resistance map / cross-section and electrical Group by angle for SIMS analysis

body.zh: 浓度；比较不同角度；的深度分布；深度
body.en: Concentration Compare depth distributions at different angles Depth

body.zh: 片阻图；评估均匀性
body.en: Sheet-resistance map Assess uniformity

body.zh: 截面与电性；验证工艺效果
body.en: Cross-section and electrical Validate process outcomes
